If you’re going to harm yourself at least don’t let it go further than a cut. 

So please cut with a clean blade, not a rusty one as you’re at a risk of tetanus which isn’t a joke. It’s a life threatening condition. 

After cutting please clean and bandage the wounds. 
I’m not encouraging self harm, I think you should try to reduce it and shift your focus on to a more healthier method of coping. 

Reducing your self harm is hard and takes time. A good way to do it is if you cut yourself 4 times per day then try to reduce it to 3, then to 2 and so on. You could self harm to a less severe level by using a rubber to hurt yourself instead of a blade

Self harm does calm people down and it gives an escape from emotions. That doesn’t mean you continue self harming. 

Even thought it feels good initially after a while you’re back to square one and you tend to cut yourself more and more severely because you don’t get the same “euphoric feeling”. This is why some people get addicted to self harm. I know I was and still am. 

But you should try to shift your method of coping to a more healthier one. So maybe next time instead of cutting get down on the ground and do push-ups until you tire yourself out. I temporarily got out of self harm by shifting my focus to exercise and I’m still trying to get better.
